findings.claim: policyBase recognizes the base branch only by stripping a literal "origin/" prefix from the candidate ref, so with base_ref naming another remote or a full ref ("upstream/main", "refs/heads/main") a human on the base branch itself is treated as a boundary: uncommitted and unpushed surface/rule changes on main are flagged, contradicting correctness-71 (HEAD at the base tip is a vacuous pass) and the README's 'on the base branch itself the diff is vacuous'.
findings.evidence: Re-read policy.go:195-219 and CheckPolicy 329-346. Sequence: gated repo, acdsl/policy.json base_ref="upstream/main" (fork workflow), checkout main == upstream/main tip, edit acdsl/registry.json, run acdsl check. GitMergeBase(HEAD, upstream/main) succeeds; GitBranch returns "main"; baseName stays "upstream/main" (TrimPrefix removes only "origin/"), so isBoundary = ("main" != "upstream/main") = true; surfaceDelta then reports registry.json differs -> exit 1. After committing on main the merge-base is still upstream/main's tip, so make audit stays red on the base branch until pushed. Spec-6 F/D4 and correctness-71 require the diff to be vacuous on the base branch / at the base tip. Same with base_ref="refs/heads/main" (baseName "refs/heads/main" != "main"). Not covered by known correctness-MAJ-9-r1 (which concerns the working policy choosing base_ref, not base-branch recognition).
findings.fix: Derive baseName from the resolved ref's branch part (git rev-parse --symbolic-full-name <candidate> -> strip refs/heads/ or refs/remotes/<remote>/), or treat HEAD == rev-parse(<candidate>) as the vacuous case per correctness-71 in addition to the branch-name match.
